title: Booking Flow Fix - Empty Appointment Types Dropdown
description: Fix the employer portal booking flow where Appointment Type dropdown shows NO OPTIONS due to empty appointmentTypes table. Also addresses critical security vulnerabilities and UX gaps.

rootCause.issue: appointmentTypes database table is EMPTY (0 records)
rootCause.impact: CRITICAL - Booking flow completely blocked at Step 1

phases.name: Data Seeding
phases.description: Seed appointment types via Convex CLI to unblock booking flow immediately

tasks.description: Run 5 CLI commands to populate appointmentTypes table
commands: npx convex run appointmentTypes:create '{"name":"Initial Assessment","description":"Comprehensive occupational health assessment for new employees","durationMinutes":60,"price":0}'
npx convex run appointmentTypes:create '{"name":"Follow-up Consultation","description":"Follow-up appointment after initial assessment","durationMinutes":30,"price":0}'
npx convex run appointmentTypes:create '{"name":"Health Screening","description":"General occupational health screening","durationMinutes":45,"price":0}'
npx convex run appointmentTypes:create '{"name":"Return-to-Work Assessment","description":"Assessment for employees returning after extended absence","durationMinutes":45,"price":0}'
npx convex run appointmentTypes:create '{"name":"Fitness Reassessment","description":"Periodic fitness for work reassessment","durationMinutes":30,"price":0}'
